## Description

Uses trailing bond or government-futures returns to take long/short duration exposure, often scaled by volatility.

## Where it may fit

Persistent rate trends; may help diversify equity-oriented portfolios, but can suffer abrupt policy reversals.

## Vehicles

Managed futures/CTA, global macro, bond and multi-asset portfolios.

## Required data

Total-return bond indices or futures, duration, expiry/roll data, financing, volatility and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Duration exposure must be measured explicitly; futures rolls, convexity and rate gaps can dominate signal performance.
